exploratory_monotonicity.conclusion: Only one of nine exploratory strata shows a non-flat monotone worsening pattern; the mechanism screen does not support a general complexity-dose rule.
exploratory_monotonicity.hypothesized_pattern: success effect becomes non-increasing (more harmful) along the display order
exploratory_monotonicity.order_semantics: conceptual burden order (copy, memory, memory+update, reasoning), not a validated scalar dose; all formats have fixed matched output length

headline: The powered recompute effect is negative in six of seven model/benchmark strata, but exploratory probe burden is non-monotone and one powered stratum is positive: this is a trend, not a rule.
